title: JJ Watt gets multiyear deal with CBS as lead NFL game analyst, will call Super Bowl in 2028

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: JJ Watt gets multiyear deal with CBS as lead NFL game analyst, will call Super Bowl in 2028
sources.description: JJ Watt has come to a multiyear agreement with CBS to remain Jim Nantz's NFL booth partner. Watt had been filling in since Tony Romo's July arrest and subsequent departure from the network.
